text.en:
9th. MARCH, 2006 No. S 33

TELECOMMUNICATIONS ORDER, 2001 (S 38/01) NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 1(1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 ( 1), the Minister of Communications, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. day of April, 2006 as the date on which Telecommunications Order, 2001 shall commence. Dated this 12th. day of Muharam, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 11th. day of February, 2006.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA SERI KERNA DATO SERI SETIA

HAJI AWANG ABU BAKAR BIN HAJI APONG Minister of Communications, Brunei Darussalam.
